HEALTHY WEIGHT Exclusive 7-day longevity program _ Only in Clinique La Prairie, Switzerland _ From CHF 21'500 BOOK THIS PROGRAM Insights on Healthy Weight Is Healthy Weight a medical program? Yes. All protocols are medically supervised within our longevity clinic and personalized to your health profile and goals. Can I have both dinner and breakfast during my stay? Yes. The program is normally built around intermittent fasting with eating times at lunch and dinner. However, meal timing and composition can be arranged based on individual requests. Final confirmation comes from our dietician to ensure it matches your plan and goals. How many hours of workout will I have? Is there daily personal training? You’ll have structured daily movement as part of our Healthy Weight program. One-to-one personal training sessions are tailored to your needs; we can increase frequency on request. Your exercise physiologist will set the exact plan after your assessment to support healthy weight loss. When will I see results from the Healthy Weight program? You’ll notice changes during the stay (energy, sleep, body composition trajectory). The most meaningful results - fat loss consolidation, metabolic markers, fitness - continue to improve in the weeks after with your plan. Can I take a glucometer home after the program? We’ll teach you how to use one. Clinique La Prairie devices stay onsite, but we can arrange a personal glucometer for you to purchase and take home after your stay. What happens after I leave? Is there follow-up? Yes. You’ll receive your consultation summaries, practical brochures, and actionable data. We include follow-up calls (physician and nutritionist) and guidance to integrate changes at home and through our city hubs connected to our longevity clinic. Can I extend my stay to one month for better results? Yes. Longer stays are possible. We’ll periodize training, nutrition, and recovery to keep progress safe and steady. This can all be done within the environment of our Clinique, supporting long-term healthy weight loss. Can I combine the Healthy Weight program with the Revitalisation program? Often yes. We’ll advise on the best sequencing (same trip or back-to-back) based on your medical evaluation. You can learn more about our Revitalisation Program , a regenerative health program designed to boost cellular renewal and enhance overall vitality.
